abstract: This paper presents XingChen-UniFE, a unified large audio language model (LALM) for general speech restoration (GSR) and target speaker extraction (TSE). The proposed model employs complementary semantic and acoustic representations through a dual-stream encoder, where a self-supervised learning model provides hierarchical semantic features and a learnable acoustic branch captures fine-grained structures from complex spectra. A bidirectional cross-attention module further facilitates information exchange between the two representations. The fused representation conditions the LALM for discrete speech token generation with task and speaker information. Experiments demonstrate strong performance on both GSR and TSE and robust generalization to unseen degradation conditions.

oneSentenceThesis: 针对多种退化混杂时单一模型难兼顾内容与音质的问题，该工作用语义分支保语言内容、声学分支保频率相位细节并经双向交互融合后交给大音频语言模型生成离散语音标记，在 Libri2Mix 与多退化子任务上内容指标占优但部分感知指标仍有起伏且依赖大规模合成训练。
